[[File:Mark Schaffer portrait.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Mark Schaffer.]]
'''Mark Schaffer''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 41 in the Tatooine region, from Hampton, Va.<ref name="decsq-prof" /> The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="smlist" /> From 1998 to 2001 he volunteered for Decipher as Gold 41 and playtested SWCCG expansions from [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] through [[Death Star II]].<ref name="li-exp" />

== In their own words ==

<blockquote>
Well, let's see... I'm an engineer in real life, I play at being a photographer, and I don't want to grow up.

Decipher was there showing off some of the soon to be released Star Wars CCG cards - wow! I was hooked!

Now I run a league at my demos, have 2 - 3 tournaments a month and travel around to other SM's events to play and support them.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
</blockquote>

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).

== Decipher ==

[[File:Mark Schaffer Decipher volunteer summary.png|thumb|right|300px|His own summary of his Decipher volunteer work, 1998–2001.]]
His own career summary gives the role as "Gold 41 - Volunteer and Playtesting for Star Wars CCG" at Decipher Inc., 1998–2001.<ref name="li-exp" /> In it he taught the game to new players, hosted regular tournaments in his local community, assisted Decipher at trade shows, and playtested SWCCG expansions from [[Jabba's Palace Limited|Jabba's Palace]] through [[Death Star II]], a run that includes [[Special Edition]] and [[Endor]].<ref name="li-exp" /> Outside the game he worked as an engineer.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
